sloka: दिशश्च प्रदिशः सर्वा बभूवुस्तिमिरावृताः ।पांसुवर्षेण महता दुर्दर्शं च नभो ऽभवत् ।। ६.१०८.३० ।।
transliteration: diśaśca pradiśaḥ sarvā babhūvustimirāvṛtāḥ ।pāṁsuvarṣeṇa mahatā durdarśaṁ ca nabho 'bhavat ।। 6.108.30 ।।

translations.english: Without clouds, terrific thunderbolts of Indra (rain) dropped on his (Ravana's) army all over causing unbearable sound.
